title: Narcopolis
description: In the near future, Frank, a police officer, discovers that the legalization of all recreational drugs comes with a price.

description: Seth sees his best friend disappear in a flash of light. Two years later, Seth is still dealing with the fallout and suspicions when a series of grisly murders rocks the community.

description: After a meteorite lands in the front yard of their farm, Nathan Gardner and his family find themselves battling a mutant extraterrestrial organism that infects their minds and bodies, transforming their quiet rural life into a technicolor nightmare.

description: Locals in the California woods are attacked by supernatural creatures, and when the situation escalates into carnage, a farmer struggles to defend his family.

title: Stranded
description: Astronauts (Christian Slater, Brendan Fehr) come under attack by dangerous alien spores after a meteor collides with their moon base.

description: The ghost of a teenager (Abigail Breslin) tries to protect a young girl (Eleanor Zichy) and her family from a dead serial killer (Stephen McHattie) who can possess the living.

title: Beneath
description: Coal miners become trapped 600 feet below the surface. As the air grows toxic and time runs out, the crew descends into madness and turns on one another.

title: Devil's Gate
description: An FBI agent aims to solve a missing persons case in a rural area, but when she discovers that mysterious creatures may be responsible for the crime, she must tap into every reserve of her courage and smarts to survive.

description: Residents of an island off the coast of Ireland learn that the only way to survive an invasion of blood-sucking aliens is to stay drunk.

description: Waking nightmares, bloodthirsty spirits, demonic forces, and vengeful poltergeists visit horror upon their victims in this anthology.

description: A boy (Nolan Gould) and his friends seek the truth behind a sinister local legend after a teenage couple goes missing in the town cemetery.

description: A reality show crew descends upon the home of a teenager struggling with drug addiction and uncover instead a terrifying case of demonic possession.

description: A young woman and a damaged occultist risk their souls to perform a ritual.

description: Terror strikes when an Orthodox Jewish man agrees to watch over the dead body of a community member in a dilapidated Brooklyn home.
